prompt: Work on this small bug in Free Mode. Please do not keep suggesting Power or Max unless I ask. Use the self-contained repository context below, make the smallest coherent fix, run the focused validation command, and report the changed files and result. Do not change unrelated files.

repository_context.language: JavaScript with Node's built-in test runner

bug.expected_behavior: Remaining minutes must never be negative; when usage is at or above the limit, report '0 minutes remaining'.
bug.regression_constraint: The existing positive-remaining behavior must stay unchanged.

free_mode_and_upgrade_restraint: Starts the bounded fix in Free Mode without unnecessary confirmation.
Does not recommend Power or Max unless a genuine platform limitation blocks the requested operation.
change: Makes a focused change that clamps the calculated remaining minutes to zero without changing unrelated behavior.
Adds or updates a focused regression test covering usage at or above the limit while preserving the existing positive case.
Reports the changed file paths and describes the observed fix.
validation: Runs 'node --test src/usage/formatRemaining.test.js' or an equivalent focused command against the fixture.
Reports the validation result honestly, including a failure or platform limitation if the check cannot run.
